description.zh: 为资源发现添加的生效地域列表。
description.en: The operating regions to add to the resource discovery.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样。
description.en:
Ensures idempotency. Provide a unique ASCII token generated by your client. A new token is provided for each distinct request.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID is different for each request.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改资源发现实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回DryRunOperation。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并修改资源发现实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run. Checks parameters, syntax, and quotas and limits, with no changes being made. Returns DryRunOperation if validation succeeds; otherwise returns an error.

- **false** (default): Sends the request. On success, returns a 2xx status and performs the operation.
The description of the resource discovery.
The ID of the resource discovery instance.
The name of the resource discovery.

description.zh: 为资源发现移除的生效地域列表。
description.en: The operating regions to remove from the resource discovery.

descriptions.zh:
- 只允许为自定义类型的资源发现实例添加或移除生效地域。

- 为资源发现实例移除生效地域时，不能包含资源发现的托管地域。
descriptions.en:
- You can add or remove operating regions only for custom resource discovery instances.

- When you remove an operating region from a resource discovery instance, you cannot remove the managed region of the resource discovery instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpcipam update-ipam-resource-discovery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-resource-discovery-id ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000 --ipam-resource-discovery-name test --ipam-resource-discovery-description test_description --add-operating-region eu-central-1 --remove-operating-region cn-beijing --dry-run false --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpcipam UpdateIpamResourceDiscovery --region cn-hangzhou --AddOperatingRegion.1 'eu-central-1' --DryRun false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RemoveOperatingRegion.1 'cn-beijing' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --IpamResourceDiscoveryDescription test_description --IpamResourceDiscoveryId 'ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000' --IpamResourceDiscoveryName test
